metadata.question: Was the aerosol optical depth higher over the Takalaman Desert in February 2020 than in February 2019?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy:
   - Dataset: MODIS Atmosphere Monthly Global Product (Terra first: MODIS/061/MOD08_M3; fallback Aqua: MODIS/061/MYD08_M3).
   - Periods: 2019-02-01 to 2019-03-01 and 2020-02-01 to 2020-03-01.
   - Location: Taklamakan Desert approximated by rectangle [76E,36N,90E,41N].

2. Masking strategy:
   - Monthly gridded product already averages valid observations; no explicit cloud mask. Validate usable data by counting non-null pixels of the AOD band and report coverage percentage.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error:
   - If collection size is 0 for a month even after fallback → C1.
   - If valid pixel count (count reducer) is 0 → C2.
   - If mean is null/NaN or outside realistic range [0, 5] → C3.
   - Otherwise, compare means: higher in Feb 2020 than Feb 2019 → A, else B.
</thinking>

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function getInfoAsync(eeObject) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    eeObject.getInfo((res, err) => {
      if (err) reject(err);
      else resolve(res);
    });
  });
}

function startEndOfMonth(year, month) {
  const start = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, month, 1);
  const end = start.advance(1, 'month');
  return { start, end };
}

async function pickMonthlyImage(region, year, month) {
  const { start, end } = startEndOfMonth(year, month);
  const terraId = 'MODIS/061/MOD08_M3';
  const aquaId = 'MODIS/061/MYD08_M3';

  let colTerra = ee.ImageCollection(terraId).filterDate(start, end);
  let sizeTerra = await getInfoAsync(colTerra.size());
  if (sizeTerra > 0) {
    return { img: colTerra.first(), src: 'Terra MOD08_M3' };
  }
  let colAqua = ee.ImageCollection(aquaId).filterDate(start, end);
  let sizeAqua = await getInfoAsync(colAqua.size());
  if (sizeAqua > 0) {
    return { img: colAqua.first(), src: 'Aqua MYD08_M3' };
  }
  return { img: null, src: null };
}

function chooseAODBand(bandNames) {
  const preferred = [
    'Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Ocean_Mean_Mean', // common, 550 nm combined
    'Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Mean_Mean',
    'Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Ocean_Mean_Mean'
  ];
  for (const b of preferred) {
    if (bandNames.includes(b)) return b;
  }
  // Fallback: first band that contains both substrings
  for (const b of bandNames) {
    if (b.includes('Aerosol_Optical_Depth') && b.includes('Mean_Mean')) return b;
  }
  return null;
}

async function monthStats(region, year, month) {
  const pick = await pickMonthlyImage(region, year, month);
  if (!pick.img) return { status: 'C1' };

  const bands = await getInfoAsync(pick.img.bandNames());
  const band = chooseAODBand(bands || []);
  if (!band) return { status: 'D', note: 'AOD band not found' };

  // Compute valid count and mean over region
  const imgBand = pick.img.select(band);
  const meanDict = imgBand.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry: region,
    scale: 100000,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  });
  const countDict = imgBand.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry: region,
    scale: 100000,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  });
  const totalDict = ee.Image(1).reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry: region,
    scale: 100000,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  });

  let mean = await getInfoAsync(meanDict.get(band));
  let count = await getInfoAsync(countDict.get(band));
  let total = await getInfoAsync(totalDict.get('constant'));

  if (!count || count === 0) return { status: 'C2', src: pick.src, band, count: count || 0, total: total || 0 };
  if (mean === null || mean === undefined || !isFinite(mean)) return { status: 'C3' };
  if (mean < 0 || mean > 5) return { status: 'C3' };

  const cov = total ? (100.0 * count / total) : null;
  return {
    status: 'OK',
    src: pick.src,
    band,
    mean,
    count,
    total,
    coverage: cov
  };
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions: Taklamakan Desert approx bbox
    const region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([76.0, 36.0, 90.0, 41.0], null, false);

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    const s2019 = await monthStats(region, 2019, 2);
    const s2020 = await monthStats(region, 2020, 2);

    // Early exits for collection issues
    if (s2019.status === 'C1' || s2020.status === 'C1') {
      console.log(`2019 Feb: ${s2019.status === 'C1' ? 'No image' : 'OK'}`);
      console.log(`2020 Feb: ${s2020.status === 'C1' ? 'No image' : 'OK'}`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    if (s2019.status === 'D' || s2020.status === 'D') {
      console.log(`Band error: ${s2019.status === 'D' ? '2019' : ''} ${s2020.status === 'D' ? '2020' : ''}`.trim());
      console.log('D');
      return;
    }
    if (s2019.status === 'C2' || s2020.status === 'C2') {
      const r19 = s2019.status === 'C2' ? s2019 : null;
      const r20 = s2020.status === 'C2' ? s2020 : null;
      if (r19) console.log(`2019 Feb valid px: 0/${r19.total || 0}`);
      if (r20) console.log(`2020 Feb valid px: 0/${r20.total || 0}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (s2019.status === 'C3' || s2020.status === 'C3') {
      console.log('Calculation failed (null/invalid)');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing & Evidence
    const cov19 = s2019.coverage !== null ? s2019.coverage.toFixed(1) : 'NA';
    const cov20 = s2020.coverage !== null ? s2020.coverage.toFixed(1) : 'NA';
    console.log(`Dataset 2019: ${s2019.src}, Band: ${s2019.band}`);
    console.log(`Dataset 2020: ${s2020.src}, Band: ${s2020.band}`);
    console.log(`2019 Feb AOD mean: ${s2019.mean.toFixed(3)} (valid px: ${s2019.count}/${s2019.total}, cov: ${cov19}%)`);
    console.log(`2020 Feb AOD mean: ${s2020.mean.toFixed(3)} (valid px: ${s2020.count}/${s2020.total}, cov: ${cov20}%)`);
    const diff = s2020.mean - s2019.mean;
    console.log(`Difference (2020-2019): ${diff.toFixed(3)}`);

    // 4. Final Answer
    if (diff > 0) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    // Syntax/method/memory or other failure
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
